bullets: Add MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md pattern for the SDK-sample Status/NotifyUser area: the RelativePanel fill-graph (Frame.Above=StatusPanel + StatusPanel.AlignBottomWithPanel) silently drops the bottom bar in WinUI 3; convert to a two-row Grid (* + Auto) container swap. Fixes the whole Windows-universal-samples family's persistent status surface.

Widen render-verification in SKILL.md Step 3 and PATTERNS.md#silent-navigation-failures to require checking persistent shell chrome (Status/NotifyUser area, title/header, footer), not just per-scenario frames, so a missing shell surface is caught before declaring done.
deferred_to_human: Compare-Parity structural gate passed 100/100 with 0 controls/0 actions (runtime-generated rows) and missed the absent Status area — an eval-skill (winui3-parity-check) limitation, not edited here.
